terms.comment: A hold on which we place a foot: our descriptive foothold phrase.

phrases.english: Put your foot on this hold.

sources: Lewis & Short: ansa · Lewis & Short: impono

L&S ansa documents handles and things taken hold of. The hold and route senses above are our semantic extensions. Examples are composed for conversation with the child; dictionary links document the component words, not these exact sentences or standardized modern climbing terminology.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
